title: WHEELING MINERS UNVEIL OFFICIAL COLORS FOR NEW ERA OF MINERS FOOTBALL - Wheeling Miners
description: WHEELING, W.Va. — As the Wheeling Miners continue building toward their return to the National Arena League in 2027, the organization today officially unveiled the colors that will define the next chapter of Miners football.

title: WHEELING MINERS DIGGING INTO THEIR WHEELING ROOTS - Wheeling Miners
description: WHEELING, WV — As the Wheeling Miners continue preparations for their return to the National Arena League in 2027, the organization is taking the opportunity to reconnect its identity with the history, character and working-class spirit of the Ohio Valley.

title: WHEELING MINERS BEGIN BUILDING TOWARD 2027 RETURN TO THE NATIONAL ARENA LEAGUE - Wheeling Miners
description: WHEELING, WV — Following the conclusion of this week’s National Arena League meetings in Las Vegas, the Wheeling Miners are officially moving forward with preparations for the organization’s return to the NAL for the 2027 season.

title: We're Back in the National Arena League - Wheeling Miners
